TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_competency
TABLE.COMMENT: The LTC competency framework, as declared in moodle/site/. Holds no user data. Rows are retired, never deleted.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency name, verbatim from competencies.yaml

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: Category key, verbatim from competencies.yaml

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based position across the whole framework

FIELD.NAME: retired
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once the competency is no longer declared

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_comp
TABLE.COMMENT: Which competencies each published course aims at, written by local_ltuse_set_course_competencies. Holds no user data.

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_course_badge
TABLE.COMMENT: Which badge is each published course's completion badge, written by local_ltuse_set_course_recognition (spec 013, R1). A badge has no idnumber, so this map is its identity. Holds no user data.

FIELD.NAME: imagehash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the template image the badge's image was made from; core resizes it, so the stored files cannot be compared

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_mentor_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: Message contacts local_ltuse made between a mentor and their learner (spec 003, research R5), so ending the relationship removes only those.

FIELD.NAME: mentorid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the mentor

FIELD.NAME: learnerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the learner

FIELD.NAME: contactid
FIELD.COMMENT: message_contacts.id of the contact this plugin made, so only that one is ever removed

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_booking
TABLE.COMMENT: Each office-hours booking's last notified time (spec 011, research R20), because core's calendar_event_updated carries no old time. One row per learner booking event.

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: event.id of the learner's SSstu: calendar event

FIELD.NAME: learnerid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the learner who booked

FIELD.NAME: mentorid
FIELD.COMMENT: user.id of the slot's teacher when the booking was made

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: the start as last notified

FIELD.NAME: timeduration
FIELD.COMMENT: the length in seconds as last notified

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_protection
TABLE.COMMENT: Identity protection, one row per protected user (spec 016, research R5). Holds the real identity of a person at risk: learner data, Moodle only, never in the repo.

FIELD.NAME: ownlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: none, email, firstname or pseudonym: the user's own level

FIELD.NAME: effectivelevel
FIELD.COMMENT: the level applied to the account: the stricter of ownlevel and the organisation minimum

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: own, organisation or organisation-kept

FIELD.NAME: realfields
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON {field: {value, taken}}, each taken when that field first became withheld (R5)

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_org_protection
TABLE.COMMENT: Each organisation's minimum protection level (spec 016, research R12). Set by the site team; Moodle only, because declaring it would publish which partners are at risk.

FIELD.NAME: orgkey
FIELD.COMMENT: an organisation key declared in organisations.yaml

FIELD.NAME: minlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: none, email or firstname

TABLE.NAME: local_ltuse_protection_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Every change of a user's protection: who, when, from and to which level (spec 016, FR-008). Moodle only.

FIELD.NAME: actorid
FIELD.COMMENT: who made the change; 0 once that person is deleted

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: own, organisation, organisation-kept or correction
